import os
import requests

def write_correlated_logs(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    api_key = config.get("api_key") or os.environ["DATADOG_API_KEY"]
    site = config.get("site") or os.environ.get("DATADOG_SITE", "datadoghq.com")
    source = config.get("source", "python")
    service = config.get("service", "application")
    host = config.get("host") or os.environ.get("HOSTNAME", "localhost")
    correlation_id = (
        payload.get("correlation_id")
        or payload.get("request_id")
        or config.get("correlation_id")
        or config.get("request_id")
    )
    message = payload.get("message") or str(payload)
    dd_tags = list(config.get("ddtags", []))
    if correlation_id:
        dd_tags.append(f"correlation_id:{correlation_id}")
    url = f"https://http-intake.logs.{site}/api/v2/logs"
    headers = {
        "DD-API-KEY": api_key,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }
    body = [{
        "message": message,
        "ddsource": source,
        "service": service,
        "hostname": host,
        "status": payload.get("status", "info"),
        "ddtags": ",".join(dd_tags),
        "attributes": {
            "correlation_id": correlation_id,
            "request_id": payload.get("request_id"),
            "logger": payload.get("logger"),
            "extra": payload.get("extra", {}),
        },
    }]
    response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=body, timeout=config.get("timeout", 10))
    response.raise_for_status()
    result = {
        "provider": "datadog",
        "status_code": response.status_code,
        "correlation_id": correlation_id,
        "accepted": True,
    }
    return result
